result.summary: Attacking forward runs into space behind the defensive line, strikes a lofted finish over the advancing goalkeeper, and scores into the top corner.

observations.title: Attacking run into space
observations.body: The forward identifies the opening between defenders and makes a direct forward run into the penalty box to receive in stride.

observations.title: First-time chipped finish
observations.body: Upon meeting the ball under defensive pressure, the attacker lifts a high shot over the onrushing goalkeeper directly into the goal.
